name: flows
description: Conductor skills: each runs the skills this marketplace ships, in order, with approval gates and a state file to resume from. Build (/feature-flow, /research-flow, /implement, /fix-flow, /upgrade), check (/test-audit, /doc-audit, /harden, /verify), understand (/understand) and keep the lessons (/learn). Installing it installs every plugin its conductors use.
